title: Smoke Control (Colt)
activity: Smoke shafts, dampers, AOVs, fans, car park ventilation
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Openings and upstands the size on the Colt assembly drawing so vents/dampers fit?
Product inspected for damage before install; CoC / DoP on file?
Ask the fitter: Has the shaft been cleaned and fire stopped at every level? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Dampers and AOVs installed square, plumb, sealed and terminated?
Containment bonded, square cut, de-burred, with end caps?
Cables clipped at least every metre, glands tight, bend radius not tighter than 6× diameter?
Junction boxes fixed with lids screwed down and warning labels?
DPIO/CSIO/BBU units and interface modules with IP rating kept, lids fixed, cables labelled?
MCC panel and ATS in position, labelled, cross-bonded, keys in and padlocked?
Fans: duty/standby labels, isolator cross-bonded, fan direction checked, AV mounts sized?
Fire switches / MCPs at about 1.4 m above floor with covers; OPV panel in position?
questions.source: BS 5839-1 (call point height); Colt inspection sheet

questions.q: Labels fitted, no damage, area clean?
Fans in the drawn location, airflow arrow the right way, clear of obstructions?
CO detectors in conduit with guards at 1500–1700 mm from FFL?
Inlet dampers installed square, plumb, sealed and terminated?
Cause and effect (SAT 3) tested with the fire alarm and witnessed?

notOk.t: Smoke shaft base blocked with debris
Fire stopping, parge coat or mastic incomplete inside shafts
Damper too close to the wall / access panel fire stopped over
Services crossing in front of smoke shafts / below 2100 mm
Smoke tape missing; screw heads visible on smoke seals
AOV wrong RAL colour / water ponding on AOV
